description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class 'BaseViewEmployeeController' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the PIM (Personal Information Management) plugin. The class manages employee view rendering, access control, and permissions handling for employee data, utilizing traits, services, and a framework for handling requests and components.

classes.name: BaseViewEmployeeController
classes.description: Abstract controller class for viewing employee details, handling permissions, and UI component setup in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin.

methods.name: getPimLeftMenuService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the PIMLeftMenuService instance used for managing employee menu items.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Prepares and renders the employee view, adding properties like tabs, allowed file types, and max file size to the component.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify data groups for permission checks.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view the specified employee data based on their role and permissions.

methods.name: setPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Sets the user's permissions for a specific employee in the context, based on data groups.

methods.name: isEmployeeAccessible
methods.description: Determines if the logged-in user can access the employee's data, either by role permission or if the employee is themselves.
